card.title: Spare Them the Hassle
card.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 protects rest after a night ward shift, A3 minimizes water while serving food and A5 takes over bedding to avoid involving B upstairs.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bucket question causes A3 sofa diversion; B4 upstairs plan causes A5 duvet relocation and minimized drying explanation.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices a practical anomaly and B4 proposes a sensible route to sleep.

heightening.evidence: B4 plan threatens discovery of the larger problem, so A5 adds personal work to keep B resting away from it.

specificity.evidence: A1 exhausted loved one and B2 bucket establish care and a concealed home problem.
